propositions: A new blocking check p10_verification_presence requires a leaf plan to have a Testing/Verification H2 section or an AC item with an inline code span or verification-vocabulary regex match.
A new blocking check p11_ac_vagueness scans AC item lines with a boundary-fixed vague lexicon, dropping 'clean' which previously fired on word prefixes like 'cleanly'.
Inline code-span positions are recorded on the original line so lexicon hits inside spans never fire, and 'etc.' within 30 characters after a span end is exempted.
P6 (p6_ac_quality) stays advisory but its lexicon is updated to the same fixed matcher so both surfaces agree.
Backtests over 153-ticket and 200-ticket sets justified the two floor additions, while spec-by-example/riskiest-assumption floors were rejected for poor discrimination.
docs/plan-review-gate.md's deterministic-floor prose is extended to document P10 and P11.
